items.text: Iri ndiro shoko raJehovha rakauya kuna Jeremia muprofita pamusoro pendudzi:

Iri ndiro shoko pamusoro pehondo yaFaro Neko mambo weIjipiti, yakakundwa paKarikemishi, paRwizi Yufuratesi naNebhukadhinezari mambo weBhabhironi mugore rechina raJehoyakimi mwanakomana waJosia mambo weJudha:
Asi zuva iro nderaShe, iye Jehovha Wamasimba Ose,
iro zuva rokutsiva, rokutsiva vavengi vake.
Nokuti Ishe, iye Jehovha Wamasimba Ose, achabayira chibayiro
Iri ndiro shoko rakataurwa naJehovha kuna Jeremia muprofita, pamusoro pokuuya kwaNebhukadhinezari mambo weBhabhironi kuzorwa neIjipiti achiti:
Havangagoni kumira, nokuti Jehovha achavadzikisa pasi.
ane zita rinonzi Jehovha Wamasimba Ose,
"pano mumwe achauya akaita seTabhori pakati pamakomo,
Rongedzai zvinhu zvenyu, nokuti muchaenda kuutapwa,
Varwi vanorwa kuti varipirwe mari chete vari mairi,
Naivowo vachatendeuka uye vachatiza pamwe chete,
nokuti zuva renjodzi riri kuuya pamusoro pavo,

Jehovha Wamasimba Ose, Mwari weIsraeri, anoti, "Ndava pedyo nokuuyisa shamhu pamusoro paAmoni mwari weTebhesi, napamusoro paFaro, neIjipiti navamwari vayo namadzimambo ayo, napamusoro peavo vanovimba naFaro.
Ndichavaisa mumaoko eavo vanotsvaka kuvauraya, nokuna Nebhukadhinezari mambo weBhabhironi namachinda ake. Shure kwaizvozvo, Ijipiti ichagarwa sepamazuva akare," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha.
Zvirokwazvo ndichakuponesa uri kunzvimbo iri kure,
nezvizvarwa zvako kubva kunyika youtapwa hwavo,
